attributes.action: MPs who resign can’t stand in subsequent by-election
attributes.additional_details: Constituents should not be used as political weapons to support political careers. An MP should be a staunch representative of their constituency. If they resign mid-way through a term as the MP for that constituency, it is because they feel they can no longer fulfil that role. They should not then have the ability to be nominated as a candidate in the forthcoming by-election to replace them, as they’ve said they can’t fulfil the role.
attributes.background: If an MP decides to resign mid-way between general elections, therefore triggering a by-election, they should not be permitted to then stand in that by-election. If they’ve resigned, they don’t feel they can represent their constituents, so shouldn’t be permitted to immediately in that constituency

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Prevent MPs who resign their seat from standing for re-election for 12 months" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776390
